input.quote: This Agreement shall not be deemed to create a partnership or joint venture and neither Party is the other's agent, partner, employee or representative.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", and "personnel" return no non-solicitation, no-hire, or inducement covenant anywhere in the agreement, and the personnel-related provisions (§ 5.4 General Managers; § 10.2 independent contractor / no joint venture) impose no hiring restrictions on the Company. The restrictive covenants that do exist (§ 6 Exclusivity) address competing web projects rather than employees, and § 6.3's two-year restraint binds HDI, not us. The agreement therefore sits at the preferred position — no non-solicit binding the Customer — so no redline is warranted.
